parent.baseline: WSP89 source-backed structured knowledge DEV pass; symbolic and trained control tie; WSP89 QID source cohort consumed

hypothesis: Directly written fixed-width hashed raw-character feature weights learned from labeled Wikipedia lead excerpts can identify a country-capital relation in new natural prose from country-disjoint articles, distinguish municipal/regional capital references from national capital references, and retain old reading associations after new demonstrations without SGD updates.
limits: This is CLOSED-WORLD candidate selection between two prechosen city pages per country, supplied with the country string. It is NOT freeform QA, open-world reading, unconstrained entity discovery, autonomous fact research, latent knowledge comparable to LLMs, or superior to fully trained conventional models. Supervised capital/not-capital demonstration labels are provided for training cities. Each candidate already has its title and country grouping; selecting one is not independent fact discovery.

source.license: CC BY-SA 4.0, separate attributed dataset files; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Copyrights
source.collection: exactly 40 predeclared city article titles, fetched in two 20-title requests; source file stores no capital/control labels, article title, page ID, reported revision ID, page_url, per-page attribution and precise captured text, per-batch response SHA256 and canonical SHA256; reject missing/empty/redirect ambiguity, no replacement city or post-hoc source selection; source text frozen before DEV evaluation; no live source calls from model code.
source.novelty: None of the 24 heldout wiki city pages are involved in label supervision, and no reserved scores may be inspected before exact-source final qualification. Wikimedia is a single publisher; input domains (country capital city entries) are closely related; not independent publisher transfer.

candidate.raw_signal: Unicode NFC case-folded raw character overlapping 3-5grams hashed by stable Blake2 to 16,384 numeric dimensions; no word tokenizer, transformer, next-token model or pretrained text representations. Mask only explicit city title/country strings before feature extraction (using literal character replacement, not a source-specific regex grammar); do not mask capital cue words.
candidate.learning: Fixed numerical bipolar class-association writes from 6 pairs of labeled Wikipedia city texts, then 2 extra pairs; no gradients, refit or past observation replay for candidate. Scores from weight dot product of source text features, choose top within each country pair, with abstention margin frozen.
candidate.state: Sparse numeric relation weights and separately stored source citation records; exact cold-state serializable checksum; no claim all evidence resides solely in weights.
candidate.evaluation: Provide candidate input as (country, [(title, raw lead excerpt, verified source reference) for two city pages]) in deterministic alphabetical title order. Never pass 'capital' or 'control' roles into predict(). Scoring manifest can be read by evaluator only AFTER output hash is committed.

controls.fully_trained: Conventional supervised SGD logistic regression on identical raw-character features and labeled fixture examples; 120 full deterministic epochs, learning rate 1.0 and L2 0.01, report train accuracy, dev predictions, actual compute. Do not undertrain intentionally.
controls.lexical: Independent explicit same-country 'capital of' substring and pattern parser; no access to capital labels for DEV; report its ability even if it wins.
controls.retrieval: BM25-like lexical similarity of query 'capital of {country}' against both article texts, report dev wins (no training).
controls.shuffled: Direct-weight negative control trained with labels swapped independently across fixture pairs, preserving 50/50 class counts; report dev performance.
controls.random: Fixed seed random-choice control, no source use.

metrics.meaning: Even a full pass cannot claim general natural language understanding or independently acquired world knowledge. All models see source prose; two answer options and correct country grouping are preselected.

qualification: Preregistration committed before collector/experiment code or source capture.
Read-only one-shot source capture under 40-page ceiling, two requests and bounded bytes, with exact file hash/attribution; if any source missing fail closed and report, do not substitute post-hoc.
Public fixture train/validation only; no DEV first-use, no tuning or training on DEV labels.
Mandatory WSP80-WSP90 focused, full Yggdrasil root regression, exact source/G29 on Ubuntu+Windows; preserve original failed tests and measurements.
Dev group first-use once only after both OS qualification; preserve failure without retuning the reserved split or changing threshold, report baselines and whole-process costs.
Publish results in GitHub, leave accepted state untouched.
